extraction: dmux-workflows uses tmux panes for parallel agent execution — each lane (A/B/C) gets dedicated pane with isolated worktree. Engine in pane 0 (Lane A: builds engines), Verdict in pane 1 (Lane B: verifies), Miss in pane 2 (Lane C: applies + monitoring). Built-in sync via dmux send-keys for handoff signals. Maps to our 18-lang OCR goal by enabling parallel subagent lanes without cloud orchestration.
decision_it_changes: W6 rollout: whether we adopt dmux for Lane A/B/C parallelism vs sequential single-agent loop
transfer_harness_fact: 18 Indic langs, weak cells, 200-dpi citizen docs, no paid keys, no training until W6 freeze, offline pipeline
